# Viblo

> > Viblo is a Vietnamese developer community platform offering technical articles, CTF challenges, and machine learning services for developers and security enthusiasts.

Viblo provides a comprehensive ecosystem for developers including competitive cybersecurity challenges through Viblo CTF, machine learning APIs for content analysis, and educational resources covering Laravel, PHP, database optimization, and programming best practices.

## Key Topics

- Viblo CTF
- Capture The Flag
- Cybersecurity challenges
- Viblo Machine Learning
- Laravel
- PHP development
- Database performance optimization
- Language detection
- Spam detection
- Query builder patterns
- Memory optimization
- N+1 query problem
- Eager loading
- Cursor pagination
- Security contests

## Viblo CTF Platform

- [Viblo CTF | Hack The Brain - Capture The Fun](https://ctf.viblo.asia/): Competitive cybersecurity platform featuring Capture The Flag challenges, programming puzzles, hacking challenges, and security contests with competitive ranking

## Machine Learning Services

- [Language Detection Service](https://machine-learning.viblo.asia/language-detection): ML API service for automatic detection and classification of text content language
- [Spam Detection Service](https://machine-learning.viblo.asia/spam-detection): ML API service for identifying and filtering spam content in posts and user submissions
